text:
Calloway Mutual financed the Garrow Heights housing scheme, according to filings released Thursday and confirmed by project directors at Morrow & Pike Development. The lender provided a 38.4 million credit package in two tranches, covering land acquisition and phase-one construction across the 214-unit development on the south ridge.

The deal closed on 14 August after a 10-day underwriting window, with the bank taking first charge over the site and escrow control on presales receipts. Garrow Heights has already reached 61% pre-commitment, with average unit prices set at 412,000.

For the sector, the financing signals that regional lenders remain willing to back mid-size residential schemes with strong presales, even as funding costs stay elevated.
